snippet.title: Divider Dave | Trailer (Steam) | Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
🎮 WISHLIST ON STEAM → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4463690/Divider_Dave/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=trailer_apr2026

🆓 Free demo playable on the same page

Divider Dave is a slapstick puzzle-platformer where you clone yourself and use your doubles as tools. Throw them across gaps, stack them to reach higher ground, transform them into pushable boxes, and sacrifice them to solve increasingly absurd puzzles.

Set in a corporate clone factory with Cartoon Network 2000s vibes, Divider Dave is the first game from Chancla Interactive — a two-person indie studio.

🔧 Built in Godot
🎨 Pixel art
🎵 Original soundtrack by Tolgy → https://www.youtube.com/@tolgy_music

▶ Follow the devs:
